content:
- name: Cold-build int64 Tensors and independently qualify resources entry and owner handoff
        run: |
          status=0
          make test-integer-tensors \
            HEPTA_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.toolchain/hepta" \
            HEPTA_STACK_BUILD="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-stack-budget" \
            HEPTA_COMPILER="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-expanded/hia-native-compiler" || status=$?
          if [ -f build/hosted-integer-tensors-native.json ]; then
            python3 -I -S -B tools/emit_ci_report.py build/hosted-integer-tensors-native.json
          fi
          exit "$status"

      - name: Validate int64-profile Storage tombstones with unchanged copied rejection rules
        run: |
          status=0
          python3 -I -S -B tests/integer_frozen35_accounting/test_storage_tombstone.py \
            --binary build/integer-tensors/tensor-integer-session \
            --source build/integer-tensors/runtime.hepta \
            --protocol tests/retained_nonleaf_review/protocol.py \
            --output build/frozen35-integer-node/storage-tombstone || status=$?
          if [ -f build/frozen35-integer-node/storage-tombstone/report.json ]; then
            cp build/frozen35-integer-node/storage-tombstone/report.json build/integer-tensors-storage-tombstone.json
            python3 -I -S -B tools/emit_ci_report.py build/integer-tensors-storage-tombstone.json
          fi
          exit "$status"
